title: The Overnight Conservator
summary: 3 a.m. gallery; she dusts a kouros; it holds her champagne; she holds its broken forearm like a clipboard. Post-gala Two. Sibling hour to Master Control.
visualArc: Hard museum spot → torn ballgown → kouros with flute → condition report in lipstick.
